extra.final_summary: The data had several issues: (1) the 'species' column had case, space, and spelling variants (e.g., 'adelie', 'Adeile', 'Gentoo ') that were normalized to the allowed labels; (2) one row (row 36) had an invalid flipper length of -200.0 mm, which was below the minimum of 170.0 mm per the rules and was excluded; (3) the 'body_mass_g' column had values stored as text with commas (e.g., '3,750'), which were successfully converted to numbers. After these fixes, the analysis was run on Adelie penguins only. The average bill length by island is: Biscoe: 40.93 mm, Dream: 38.75 mm, Torgersen: 40.70 mm. The 'sex' column had 2 missing values, but they were not fixed as per the rules (missing means unknown).
